subsystems.name: Ice-drilling system
subsystems.role: melts a hole through kilometres of ice to reach the lake.

subsystems.name: Clean-access and sterilisation system
subsystems.role: ensures nothing from the surface contaminates the lake.

subsystems.name: Sampling and analysis probe
subsystems.role: collects water, sediment and microbes from the lake.
parts: sensors for temperature, conductivity and oxygen

subsystems.name: Contamination verification
subsystems.role: proves that samples are pristine and any microbes found are native.

subsystems.name: Surface power and logistics
subsystems.role: supplies the heat and electricity for drilling and camp.

subsystems.name: Cryobot (icy-moon adaptation)
subsystems.role: a self-melting probe to access subsurface oceans on icy moons.

buildSteps.title: Survey the ice and lake
buildSteps.detail: Use ice-penetrating radar and seismic sounding to map ice thickness, lake depth and bed topography.

buildSteps.title: Design the clean-access plan
buildSteps.detail: Specify sterilisation for every component that will enter the borehole, and plan tracer tests.

buildSteps.title: Drill the borehole
buildSteps.detail: Circulate hot water through a hose to melt a hole, keeping it open with a recirculating system.

buildSteps.title: Sterilise and deploy the probe
buildSteps.detail: Lower a sterilised probe on a tether through the borehole into the lake.

buildSteps.title: Sample and measure
buildSteps.detail: Collect water and sediment, run in-situ sensors, and filter microbes for later analysis.

buildSteps.title: Verify cleanliness
buildSteps.detail: Analyse tracers and blanks to confirm that no surface contamination reached the lake.

buildSteps.title: Refreeze and monitor
buildSteps.detail: Allow the borehole to refreeze and monitor the lake for any disturbance.

buildSteps.title: Adapt for icy moons
buildSteps.detail: Engineer a cryobot with a nuclear heat source and a tether, then test it in Antarctic glaciers.

prerequisites.why: it is the proven method to melt through kilometres of ice quickly.
demonstrated in a few lakes but not yet standardised or routine.
molecular methods can detect trace microbes and tracer particles.
melt probes have been tested in glaciers, but a flight-ready cryobot for Europa is not yet built.
tethers work for kilometres, but wireless data through thick ice remains limited.

pathway.milestone: Access to a handful of subglacial lakes such as Lake Whillans and Lake Mercer with clean hot-water drilling.
pathway.unlocks: direct sampling of isolated microbial ecosystems and validation of clean-access methods.

pathway.milestone: More lakes explored with improved sterilisation and autonomous probes, including real-time DNA sequencing.
pathway.unlocks: a broader picture of subglacial habitability and a repeatable clean-access toolkit.

pathway.milestone: Cryobot tests in Antarctic subglacial lakes and glaciers.
pathway.unlocks: proven melt-probe technology for planetary missions.

pathway.milestone: Cryobots exploring the subsurface oceans of Europa and Enceladus.
pathway.unlocks: the first direct search for life in an ocean beyond Earth.
